text:
SIPALG::hairpin
Description
This iRules command gets or sets the value of hairpin flag for the current message.
Syntax
SIPALG
::
hairpin
[
detect
|
disable
|
enable
]
SIPALG::hairpin
Returns the value of the hairpin flag for the current message.
SIPALG::hairpin <detect | disable | enable>
Returns ‘detect’, ‘disable’, or ‘enable’
Examples
when
SIP_REQUEST
{
log
local0.
"message hairpin mode [SIPALG::hairpin]"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
SIP_REQUEST, SIP_REQUEST_SEND, SIP_RESPONSE, SIP_RESPONSE_SEND, MR_INGRESS, MR_EGRESS, MR_FAILED
Introduced: BIGIP-15.0
